name: AirapSong
tagline: AI song and rap video studio: make songs from prompts or lyrics, generate cover art, and turn your photos into a five-second Hotel Lobby rap
description: AirapSong is an online AI song and rap video studio. Describe your idea or write custom lyrics, choose a sound (trap, boom bap, drill, melodic rap, pop, R&B, lo-fi, rock), set vocal direction and tempo, or make an instrumental track. Create cover artwork from a text prompt or reference image, then turn your photos into a five-second Hotel Lobby rap video (768P / 2K) with scene concepts like Orange Booth, Neon Afterhours and Corgi Cypher. Pay-as-you-go one-time credit packs; English and Chinese interface.
